escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Africa this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, They RUINED My $30,000 Couch... 😭, by Turner, with over 4 thousand comments.
In second place, تفجير بكج البالون دور كامل 🤯🔥 كارت خارق لهاري كين…, by JIGGSo_ar, with over 6 thousand comments.
And number one: Can You Fight With A Sword In Your Mouth? 🤔, by Zack D. Films, with over 6 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
